description: This file defines an interface 'WithSender' parameterized by a type extending 'WithDittoHeaders'. It represents a message bundled together with its sender ActorRef, providing methods to access and replace the message, as well as a static factory method to create instances.

classes.name: WithSender
classes.description: An interface representing a message paired with its sender ActorRef, with methods to access and manipulate the message and sender.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message contained in this object.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Returns a new WithSender instance with the message replaced by newMessage.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a WithSender instance with specified message and sender.
